entities.name: Zorian Kazinski
entities.summary: Third-year mage at Cyoria's academy and the disfavored fourth Kazinski child. Dragged unwillingly into a month-long time loop, he becomes a hidden second looper alongside Zach, methodically mastering magic across countless restarts to survive the summer-festival invasion and unravel who built the loop.

facts.value: shaping, mind magic, later soul magic

entities.name: Zach Noveda
entities.summary: Wealthy, reckless golden-boy student and the original anchor of the time loop. He dies over and over trying to stop the invasion by force, unaware for a long time that Zorian loops with him. His hidden angelic contract sits at the heart of the loop.

entities.name: Kirielle Kazinski
entities.summary: Zorian's energetic, mischievous younger sister who badgers her way into coming to Cyoria. Her presence softens Zorian and grounds his home life across the stable loops.

facts.value: boundless energy; secretly loves to draw

entities.name: Daimen Kazinski
entities.summary: The eldest Kazinski brother, a famous, charismatic adventurer traveling abroad in Koth. Idolized by strangers and resented by Zorian for his effortless favor.

entities.name: Fortov Kazinski
entities.summary: A middle Kazinski brother, a socialite and poor student, at the academy alongside Zorian.

entities.name: Xvim Chao
entities.summary: Zorian's assigned mentor, a severe, taciturn instructor who drills him with the marble exercise. His maddening methods eventually forge Zorian's reflexive spellcasting.

entities.name: Ilsa Zileti
entities.summary: Academy administrator who handles Zorian's enrollment, mentor assignment, and quietly points him toward lodging and advanced instruction.

entities.name: Imaya Kuroshka
entities.summary: Warm middle-aged landlord and a friend of Ilsa who rents rooms to Zorian, Kirielle, and Kael. She dotes on the children and turns her house into a real home.

entities.name: Kael Tverinov
entities.summary: A morlock alchemist and single father boarding at Imaya's with his toddler Kana. He becomes Zorian's alchemy mentor and steadfast ally, expert in potions and soul-adjacent lore.

entities.name: Kana
entities.summary: Kael's young daughter, withdrawn until Kirielle befriends her.

entities.name: Taiven
entities.summary: A brash older student and freelance monster-hunter who repeatedly recruits Zorian for a sewer job. Stubborn and skilled, she is an early recurring fixture of the loops.

entities.name: Raynie
entities.summary: A capable, combat-oriented student who becomes a trusted teammate on later delves.

entities.name: Kyron
entities.summary: The academy's combat-magic instructor who revives banned mind-resistance training, helping Zorian harden his mind against the aranea.

entities.name: Silverlake
entities.summary: A spry ninety-year-old witch living in the forest, a rare master of soul magic. Prickly and self-interested, she becomes Zorian's crucial and dangerous soul-magic mentor.

entities.name: Alanic Zosk
entities.summary: A militant priest of Cyoria with deep knowledge of undead and curses. He leads the investigation into the soul-mage disappearances and becomes a key adult ally.

entities.name: Lukav
entities.summary: A soul mage and former associate of Alanic who explains undead and soul mechanics to Zorian.

entities.name: Novelty
entities.summary: The aranea matriarch Zorian repeatedly negotiates with, whose telepathic web becomes a crucial intelligence and training resource across the loops.

entities.name: Quatach-Ichl
entities.summary: An ancient, immensely powerful lich last known from Ulquaan Ibasa, one leader of the invasion triumvirate. His soul is anchored to a hidden phylactery, making him nearly impossible to kill.

entities.name: Red Robe
entities.summary: A masked, voice-distorted figure who leads the invasion triumvirate. Later revealed to be a rival looper contesting control of the time loop itself.

entities.name: Jornak
entities.summary: The name behind the Red Robe: a hostile Controller-rival tied to the enemy faction and Zorian's ultimate opponent for mastery of the loop.

entities.name: Sudomir Kandrei
entities.summary: The respected mayor of Knyazov Dveri and a secret servant of the Cult of the Dragon Below, orchestrating the abduction of soul mages to advance the ritual.

entities.name: Panaxeth
entities.summary: The imprisoned primordial (the Sleeper) beneath Cyoria, a fleshwarper of world-ending power. The Cult's true aim is to free and enslave it, not merely appease their dragon god.

entities.name: Cyoria
entities.summary: A great magical city built above a vast Dungeon, home to the Royal Academy of Magical Arts. Its summer festival is the night the invasion strikes and the loop's fixed endpoint.

entities.name: Royal Academy of Magical Arts
entities.summary: Cyoria's premier magic school where Zorian, Zach, and their peers study. Its mentors, archives, and instructors shape Zorian's growth loop after loop.

entities.name: The Dungeon
entities.summary: The immense labyrinth beneath Cyoria, home to monsters, the aranea, and older secrets. The invasion erupts from its depths and Panaxeth's prison lies far below.

entities.name: Knyazov Dveri
entities.summary: A town where soul mages have been quietly disappearing, ruled by the mayor Sudomir. The thread that leads Zorian to the Cult's hand in the invasion.

entities.name: Ulquaan Ibasa
entities.summary: The infamous Island of the Exiles, populated by mages banished after the Necromancer's War. Home of the necromancers, war trolls, and Quatach-Ichl who make up the invasion force.

entities.name: Cult of the Dragon Below
entities.summary: A secretive doomsday cult that worships the world-dragon god beneath the earth. Its rank-and-file believe they appease their god; the inner circle plots to release and enslave the primordial Panaxeth via the invasion.

entities.name: The Aranea
entities.summary: A hidden society of sentient, telepathic spiders dwelling in the Dungeon, bound by a shared soul-web. Potential enemies turned indispensable allies in Zorian's mind-magic education.

entities.name: The Time Loop
entities.summary: A recurring one-month restart that resets the world (but not the loopers' minds and souls) each time it ends. Anchored by a Controller, it is the story's engine, a prison, and a training ground all at once.

entities.name: The Controller
entities.summary: The individual whose soul anchors the time loop and can, in principle, end or reshape it. Determining who truly holds this role, and wresting it from a rival, drives the endgame.

entities.name: Soul Magic
entities.summary: A rare, restricted discipline that manipulates souls directly: perception, marking, and transfer. Zorian's mastery of it, taught by Silverlake, is the key to understanding the loop and matching the enemy.

entities.name: Mind Magic
entities.summary: Telepathy and mental manipulation, mostly forbidden and feared. Zorian's early loops are spent learning it from the aranea and hardening himself against it, making it his signature toolset.

entities.name: The Cyoria Invasion
entities.summary: The coordinated attack on Cyoria during its summer festival: staged artillery, elementals, and monsters covering an Ibasan-Cult strike that subverts the city's teleport wards. It is the fixed catastrophe every loop ends on.

facts.value: the Cult's ritual to reach Panaxeth

entities.name: Spear of Resolve
entities.summary: A key working Zorian develops and wields in the loops, emblem of the focused will his endless repetition forges.

plotlines.title: The Making of a Mage
plotlines.label: main story
plotlines.summary: Zorian's central arc: from a resentful, unremarkable student trapped in someone else's loop to the mage who understands the loop better than anyone and ends it on his own terms.

beats.summary: The summer-festival invasion kills Zorian on his first pass through the night.
He wakes back in his bed and grasps that time has reset around him.
He masters the shaping exercises, turning the restarts into deliberate self-training.
Chasing the soul mages leads him toward soul magic and the truth of the loop.
He gains soul perception and begins to suspect he could be a Controller himself.
Zorian engineers the optimal ending, breaking the loop with Zach alive.

plotlines.title: Zach's Long War
plotlines.label: deuteragonist arc
plotlines.summary: Zach Noveda's arc as the loop's original anchor: the golden boy who dies again and again trying to save the city by force, and whose hidden angelic contract shapes everything.

beats.summary: Zach reveals to Zorian that he too remembers the restarts, ending Zorian's isolation.
The pair compare notes and Zach's reckless dying pattern comes into focus.
Zach's brute-force campaign against the invasion peaks.
Freed from dying each loop, Zach survives into the true ending alongside Zorian.

plotlines.title: The Vanishing Soul Mages
plotlines.label: mystery
plotlines.summary: The investigation Alanic leads into soul mages disappearing around Knyazov Dveri, the thread that unravels the invasion's real architecture.

beats.summary: Zorian finds the region's soul mages have quietly vanished, and starts pulling the thread.
The trail points to Sudomir, the town's own mayor, and the Cult behind him.
Alanic's interrogations expose how much Sudomir knew about the Cult's plans.
The conspiracy behind the disappearances is fully laid bare.

plotlines.title: Pact with the Web
plotlines.label: supporting arc
plotlines.summary: Zorian's fraught diplomacy with the telepathic aranea: from a lethal first contact in the sewers to an alliance that teaches him mind magic and opens the soul-web.

beats.summary: Zorian first brushes against the aranea's soul-web beneath the city.
He wins a hearing with the matriarch instead of a fight.
A pact is sealed: knowledge and safe passage in exchange for cooperation.
The alliance holds and the web becomes Zorian's window into mind magic.

plotlines.title: The Dragon Below
plotlines.label: antagonist arc
plotlines.summary: Sudomir and the Cult of the Dragon Below's conspiracy: harvesting soul mages and staging the invasion as cover for a ritual to reach the primordial beneath Cyoria.

beats.summary: Sudomir is unmasked as the mayor steering the disappearances for the Cult.
The Cult's real aim surfaces: not appeasement but enslaving the primordial.
The conspiracy's cost in blood mounts as the plan nears completion.
Sudomir's faction makes its decisive move and is broken.

plotlines.title: The Exiles' Invasion
plotlines.label: faction arc
plotlines.summary: The Ulquaan Ibasa war effort led by the lich Quatach-Ichl: the necromancers, trolls, and artillery that turn Cyoria's festival into a massacre every single loop.

beats.summary: The invaders are traced back to Ulquaan Ibasa and its exiled mages.
Quatach-Ichl appears among the triumvirate leading the strike.
Open conflict with the Ibasan forces escalates toward the endgame.
The lich and his war are defeated in the final confrontation.

plotlines.title: The Rival in Red
plotlines.label: antagonist arc
plotlines.summary: The masked Red Robe, later named Jornak: a hostile fellow looper contesting who truly controls the loop. Zorian's most personal and dangerous adversary.

beats.summary: The Red Robe reveals a personal interest in Zach during the invasion.
Signs mount that a rival Controller is manipulating the loop from the shadows.
The betrayer's hand is exposed as the factions turn on each other.
Zorian outmaneuvers Jornak and takes the loop's ending for himself.

plotlines.title: The Witch's Apprentice
plotlines.label: mentor arc
plotlines.summary: Zorian's apprenticeship under the ancient witch Silverlake, who teaches him the forbidden art of soul magic on her own prickly, self-interested terms.

beats.summary: Zorian seeks out the reclusive witch Silverlake in the forest.
She begins teaching him the fundamentals of soul magic.
His soul-magic training matures into real, dangerous capability.

plotlines.title: A Home in Cyoria
plotlines.label: ally arc
plotlines.summary: The found family that forms around Imaya's house: Kael the alchemist, little Kana, Kirielle, and the everyday bonds that give Zorian something to fight for beyond the loop.

beats.summary: Zorian brings Kirielle to Cyoria and settles into Imaya's home.
Kael and Kana move in; Zorian becomes Kael's alchemy assistant.
In the true ending, these bonds endure past the loop's end.

plotlines.title: The Sleeper Beneath
plotlines.label: looming threat
plotlines.summary: The buried primordial Panaxeth, whose intended release is the endgame stake: a fleshwarper of world-ending power the Cult means to free and enslave.

beats.summary: The prisoner beneath Cyoria is named: the primordial Panaxeth.
The ritual to breach its prison reaches its powderkeg point.
The threat of Panaxeth's release is finally contained.
